title: Not as sturdy as I thought it was going to be for bathroom lotion bottles etc.
text:
Not as sturdy as I thought it was going to be for bathroom lotion bottles etc.. I hung this in my walk in closet across from my double sinks etc, and,
I thought this is a great idea for my lotion bottles, jars etc. Not exactly as this is nice but not made to carry Much weight, and what you put in this needs to be evenly distributed or it’s hanging lopsided.
I now notice from the picture it looks like underwear, and small short light weight bottles are in this.
The bottom is not stiff enough to hold what I wanted to use this for, as it’s not sturdy enough.
Although this would be good in a Rv to keep lite stuff all the time in , family underwear, socks , kids fold tees, toothbrush paste, first aid, stuff you don’t want load in a Rv every time your going on the road.
For the price I think this would come in handy, but for my use not so much.
